import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def matrix_multiply_precond (A B : List (List Nat)) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  A.length > 0 ∧
  A.length ≤ 10 ∧ -- Aligned with Dafny/Verus (10)
  (∀ row, row ∈ A → row.length > 0) ∧
  (∀ row, row ∈ A → row.length ≤ 10) ∧
  (∀ i j, i < A.length → j < A.length → (A.getD i []).length = (A.getD j []).length) ∧
  
  -- Value Bounds (ADDED to match references)
  (∀ row, row ∈ A → ∀ val, val ∈ row → val ≤ 100) ∧
  (∀ row, row ∈ B → ∀ val, val ∈ row → val ≤ 100) ∧

  B.length > 0 ∧
  B.length ≤ 10 ∧
  (∀ row, row ∈ B → row.length > 0) ∧
  (∀ row, row ∈ B → row.length ≤ 10) ∧
  (∀ i j, i < B.length → j < B.length → (B.getD i []).length = (B.getD j []).length) ∧
  (A.getD 0 []).length = B.length
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def inner_prod_aux (row : List Nat) (col_idx : Nat) (B : List (List Nat)) : Nat :=
  (List.range row.length).foldl (fun acc k => acc + (row.getD k 0) * ((B.getD k []).getD col_idx 0)) 0
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definitions
def matrix_multiply (A B : List (List Nat)) (h_precond : matrix_multiply_precond A B) : List (List Nat) :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  A.map (fun row => (List.range (B.getD 0 []).length).map (fun j => inner_prod_aux row j B))
  -- !benchmark @end code

def inner_product (row : List Nat) (col_idx : Nat) (B : List (List Nat)) : Nat :=
  (List.range row.length).foldl (fun acc k => acc + (row.getD k 0) * ((B.getD k []).getD col_idx 0)) 0

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def matrix_multiply_postcond (A B : List (List Nat)) (result : List (List Nat)) (h_precond : matrix_multiply_precond A B) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  result.length = A.length ∧
  (∀ row, row ∈ result → row.length = (B.getD 0 []).length) ∧
  (∀ i j, i < result.length → j < (result.getD 0 []).length →
    (result.getD i []).getD j 0 = inner_product (A.getD i []) j B)
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem getD_map_aux {α β : Type} (f : α → β) (l : List α) (i : Nat) (da : α) (db : β)
    (hi : i < l.length) : (l.map f).getD i db = f (l.getD i da) := by
  simp [List.getD, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi]

theorem getD_range_aux (n i : Nat) (hi : i < n) : (List.range n).getD i 0 = i := by
  have hi' : i < (List.range n).length := by simpa using hi
  simp [List.getD, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi']

theorem mm_getD (A B : List (List Nat)) (h : matrix_multiply_precond A B) (i : Nat)
    (hi : i < A.length) :
    (matrix_multiply A B h).getD i [] =
      (List.range (B.getD 0 []).length).map (fun j => inner_prod_aux (A.getD i []) j B) := by
  unfold matrix_multiply
  exact getD_map_aux _ _ _ [] [] hi
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem matrix_multiply_postcond_satisfied (A B : List (List Nat))
    (h_precond : matrix_multiply_precond A B) :
    matrix_multiply_postcond A B (matrix_multiply A B h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  have hA0 : 0 < A.length := h_precond.1
  have hlen : (matrix_multiply A B h_precond).length = A.length := by
    simp [matrix_multiply]
  simp only [matrix_multiply_postcond]
  refine ⟨hlen, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro row hrow
    unfold matrix_multiply at hrow
    simp only [List.mem_map] at hrow
    obtain ⟨r, _, hr⟩ := hrow
    rw [← hr]
    simp
  · intro i j hi hj
    rw [hlen] at hi
    rw [mm_getD A B h_precond 0 hA0] at hj
    simp only [List.length_map, List.length_range] at hj
    rw [mm_getD A B h_precond i hi]
    rw [getD_map_aux (fun j => inner_prod_aux (A.getD i []) j B)
      (List.range (B.getD 0 []).length) j 0 0 (by simpa using hj)]
    rw [getD_range_aux _ _ hj]
    rfl
  -- !benchmark @end proof
